backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor defining data types and CRUD endpoints for user profiles, fasting schedules, nutrition, sleep, movement, and stress entries, with role-based access control enforced on every call.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades actor stable state from an older shape (without movement/stress maps) to the new shape by initializing empty movementDayEntries and stressDayEntries maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping planned feature IDs and titles to their target source files, component dependencies, and test requirement IDs for movement/stress query keys, hooks, and dashboard panels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary of short per-file summaries for all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend structure and responsibilities.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark themes via CSS custom properties, plus Tailwind base/component/utility layers.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the LivSpan app that forces dark mode on load via an inline script to prevent a light-mode flash before React mounts.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component wrapping the app in ThemeProvider, LanguageProvider, and Toaster, and showing a branded LoadingScreen while authentication and profile data initialize.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component that uses Internet Identity for authentication, clears the React Query cache on logout, and displays localized labels with loading state.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Factor: Clickable health-factor card component with green-blue gradient backgrounds and radial overlays that visually distinguish selected from unselected states.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Fastin: A settings card component that lets authenticated users view and edit their intermittent fasting schedule (start/end hours), displaying the calculated fasting/eating protocol duration and persisting changes via a save mutation.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Interm: A dashboard panel that displays the user's current fasting phase, a live countdown timer, progress bar, and daily/weekly metrics, while embedding the FastingScheduleSettings component for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Moveme: A dashboard panel for logging daily movement data, providing selectors for activity type (walk/run/bike/gym), intensity level, and active minutes, with save/load functionality tied to today's date.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Nutrit: A dashboard panel for tracking daily nutrition inputs (calories, protein, water, body weight) with gradient sliders and progress bars, BMI/protein-target calculations, and fasting-window awareness.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/SleepP: A dashboard panel for logging nightly sleep duration and quality score using gradient sliders, displaying progress toward an 8-hour goal and a quality label, with data persisted via React Query mutations.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Stress: A dashboard panel component for logging daily stress-related health metrics (blood pressure and pulse), with form state synced to backend via React Query hooks and toast notifications on save.
frontend/src/components/genome/AnimatedH: A purely decorative SVG component rendering an animated DNA double-helix background with gradient strands, connecting base pairs, and glow filters using CSS animations.
frontend/src/components/genome/HelixSpin: A layout wrapper component that renders an animated SVG DNA helix spine alongside a central vertical axis, used to visually frame child content (genome factor markers).
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSwi: A small UI button component that toggles the application language between English and German, highlighting the active language.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileO: A gate component that shows a login prompt for unauthenticated users or an onboarding dialog to collect/edit user profile data (name, birth year, height, gender) before rendering children.
frontend/src/hooks/queryKeys.ts: Centralizes all React Query cache keys for user profile, fasting schedule, nutrition, sleep, movement, and stress queries, with helper functions for parameterized keys.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor via React Query, invalidating and refetching dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingScheduleQue: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving the caller's fasting schedule via the backend actor, with cache invalidation and toast notifications on mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingWindowTimer: React hook that calculates the current fasting/eating phase, elapsed time, remaining time, and progress percentage based on a configurable schedule, updating every second.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook for ICP, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useMovementQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving a user's daily movement entry via the backend actor, keyed by date string.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving today's nutrition entry for the authenticated user via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSleepQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving today's sleep entry for the authenticated user via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useStressQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving a user's daily stress entry via the backend actor, keyed by date string.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfileQueries: React Query hooks for fetching and saving the current user's profile via the backend actor, with actor-dependent loading state to prevent UI flashes.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageProvider.tsx: React context provider that manages the active language (English or German), persisting the selection to localStorage and defaulting to the browser's language.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Defines the TypeScript interfaces and translation objects for English and German UI strings covering all app sections including nutrition, sleep, fasting, and profile.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Simple hook that retrieves the language context (current language, setter, and translations) from the LanguageProvider, throwing if used outside it.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines a comprehensive OKLCH-based design token system for light and dark modes, including colors, gradients, and custom helix/sage palette variables.
frontend/src/lib/fastingMetrics.ts: Provides mock/demo helper functions to return hardcoded daily and weekly fasting summaries and a streak count for display purposes.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionCalculations.t: Pure utility functions for client-side nutrition math, including BMI, protein targets, progress percentages, water intake progress, and safe number parsing.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionGuidance.ts: Analyzes macro input (calories, protein, fat, carbs) and returns a deterministic guidance key string indicating the nutritional balance category for i18n lookup.
frontend/src/lib/timeFormat.ts: Shared utility functions for formatting time durations into HH:MM:SS strings and hours with one decimal place.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a single `cn` helper that merges Tailwind class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/StartDashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page that renders a DNA helix background, header with login/language controls, and a set of health factor panels (nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, fasting) toggled via a helix spine UI.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH/HSL design tokens, helix and sage color palettes, custom fonts, and keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of a health dashboard app (version 3), listing existing features, architectural notes, and requirements for sleep, movement, stress, and nutrition tracking modules. Serves as a build-planning reference for frontend ICP-based components and hooks.
